description:
Creates a binary mask of clouds and related contamination (for example cloud shadows, thin cirrus or snow, depending on the method and its options) for optical imagery.

The result has the value `1` for the pixels to mask and `0` for the valid pixels. It has the same dimensions as `data`, except the dimension of type `bands`, which is removed. Thus, the result can be given directly to the parameter `mask` of the process ``mask()``, which applies it to all bands.

The parameter `method` selects the algorithm. Each method defines the bands that `data` must contain and its options. The options of a method are standardized, so the same process gives the same result on different back-ends.

## Method `scl_dilation`

Uses the Scene Classification Layer (SCL) of Sentinel-2 surface reflectance products (processing level 2A), as generated by Sen2Cor. The option `band` selects the SCL band. The method masks pixels near clouds and cloud shadows aggressively to prevent contamination of the valid pixels. Some outliers can remain.

The algorithm is applied to each two-dimensional spatial slice (for example, each label of a temporal dimension) independently:

1. Mask of invalid pixels (small dilation):
   1. Set a pixel to `1` if its SCL value is *not* in `valid_values`, else set it to `0`.
   2. If `erosion_kernel_size` is greater than `0`, erode the result with a circular kernel of that diameter. This removes small isolated pixels.
   3. If `valid_kernel_size` is greater than `0`, convolve the result with a normalized Gaussian kernel with a width and height of `valid_kernel_size` pixels and standard deviation `valid_kernel_size / 6`. Set the pixels where the result is greater than `0.057` to `1`, else to `0`.
2. Mask of clouds (large dilation):
   1. Set a pixel to `1` if its SCL value *is* in `cloud_values`, else set it to `0`.
   2. Apply the erosion of step 1.2.
   3. If `cloud_kernel_size` is greater than `0`, convolve the result with a normalized Gaussian kernel with a width and height of `cloud_kernel_size` pixels and standard deviation `cloud_kernel_size / 6`. Set the pixels where the result is greater than `0.025` to `1`, else to `0`.
3. The result is the logical OR of the two masks.

If all kernel sizes are `0`, the method is a simple categorical SCL mask.

Kernel sizes are in pixels of `data`. For SCL at 20 m resolution, the default `cloud_kernel_size` of `201` is approximately 4 km. Back-ends should read pixels outside of the requested extent (at least half of the largest kernel size) to prevent edge effects.

The SCL classes are:

- `0`: No data
- `1`: Saturated or defective
- `2`: Dark area pixels / topographic shadows
- `3`: Cloud shadows
- `4`: Vegetation
- `5`: Not vegetated
- `6`: Water
- `7`: Unclassified
- `8`: Cloud medium probability
- `9`: Cloud high probability
- `10`: Thin cirrus
- `11`: Snow or ice

## Methods `Fmask`, `s2cloudless` and `Sen2Cor`

The same methods as in ``cloud_detection()``. `data` contains top of the atmosphere (TOA) reflectances. The mask is the result of ``cloud_detection()`` for the disturbances `cloud` and `shadow`, with a threshold that the back-end chooses. The options of these methods are not standardized.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The source data cube. It must contain the bands that the selected method requires (see the description of each method).

parameters.name: method
parameters.description:
The cloud masking method to use. To get reproducible results, you have to set a specific method.

Set to `null` to allow the back-end to choose, which will improve portability, but reduce reproducibility as you *may* get different results if you run the processes multiple times.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The options for the selected method. Options that are not given use their default values. Only the options of the method `scl_dilation` are standardized. Specifying other options will reduce portability.

band.description: The name of the SCL band in `data`.

valid_values.description: The SCL values of the valid pixels. All other pixels are dilated with `valid_kernel_size`.

cloud_values.description: The SCL values of clouds, cloud shadows and snow. These pixels are dilated with `cloud_kernel_size`.

valid_kernel_size.description: The size in pixels of the Gaussian kernel for the invalid pixels. `0` disables this dilation.

cloud_kernel_size.description: The size in pixels of the Gaussian kernel for the clouds. `0` disables this dilation.

erosion_kernel_size.description: The diameter in pixels of the circular erosion kernel, which is applied before the dilations. `0` disables the erosion.

returns.description: A binary mask with the value `1` for the pixels to mask and `0` for the valid pixels. The data cube has the same dimensions, dimension labels and resolution as `data`, except the dimension of type `bands`, which is removed.

BandNotAvailable.message: The data cube does not contain the bands that the selected method requires.
